title: The Durga Puja Edit

heroImage.alt: A vibrant celebration backdrop draped in rich traditional handcrafted silks and floral decorations.

intro: As the rhythmic beats of the dhak announce the arrival of the festival, we unveil a sanctuary of sartorial devotion. This edit is a dedicated curatorial tribute to festive heritage—combining the sheer mathematical poetry of hand-loomed sarees with the deep, shadow-casting brilliance of Odishan silver and Rajasthani brassware.
